title: Crypto Trading
content: Apply crypto trading aesthetic with exchange platform feel. Candlestick price charts with volume bars. Order book depth visualization. Trading pair selectors. Buy/sell order forms. Portfolio pie charts. Price alerts configuration. Historical trade tables. Wallet balance summaries. Market ticker strips. Liquidation warning indicators.

variants.simple: Create crypto trading interface with candlestick charts, order books, and portfolio trackers.
variants.detailed: Apply crypto trading aesthetic with exchange platform feel. Candlestick price charts with volume bars. Order book depth visualization. Trading pair selectors. Buy/sell order forms. Portfolio pie charts. Price alerts configuration. Historical trade tables. Wallet balance summaries. Market ticker strips. Liquidation warning indicators.
variants.advanced: Apply trading platform aesthetic with exchange patterns. TradingView-style candlesticks with OHLC data, MA lines overlay. Order book with bid/ask depth bars, spread display. Trading pairs: BTC/USDT format with 24h change percentage. Order forms with limit/market tabs, leverage sliders. Portfolio donut chart with asset breakdown. Price alert cards with trigger conditions. Trade history with timestamp, side, price, amount. Balance cards with available/in-order split. Scrolling ticker with green/red price changes. Margin call warnings with liquidation price.
